other_failure_modes.name: Encoding and vectorization before cross-validation
other_failure_modes.description: Text vectorizers (like TF-IDF) and categorical encoders are fit on the entire training set before cross-validation splits are created. This leaks validation set vocabulary and distribution statistics into the training folds, making validation scores and early stopping slightly overoptimistic.

summary: The agent provides a strong solution with impressive custom feature engineering to parse complex text fields for age, weight, and units. However, it applies random cross-validation on data containing temporal components, risking look-ahead bias, and relies on a naive, unweighted ensemble. Furthermore, fitting TF-IDF and OrdinalEncoders on the entire training set before cross-validation introduces minor data leakage into the early stopping mechanism.
